Alias.name: safezone commands
Alias.script: local cmd = matches[2] if cmd == "list" then safezone.listZones() elseif cmd == "items" then safezone.listItems() elseif cmd == "status" then safezone.status() elseif cmd == "addroom" then safezone.addRoom(nil) elseif cmd:sub(1, 8) == "addroom " then safezone.addRoom(cmd:sub(9)) elseif cmd == "rmroom" then safezone.removeRoom() elseif cmd:sub(1, 8) == "addzone " then safezone.addZone(cmd:sub(9)) elseif cmd:sub(1, 7) == "rmzone " then safezone.removeZone(cmd:sub(8)) elseif cmd:sub(1, 8) == "additem " then safezone.addItem(cmd:sub(9)) elseif cmd:sub(1, 7) == "rmitem " then safezone.removeItem(cmd:sub(8)) end

Script.name: IceSafeZone
Script.script:
-- ============================================================ -- Icesus Safe Zone Manager -- ============================================================ -- Removes forbidden items when you enter a "safe" location and -- re-equips them when you leave. -- -- A location counts as safe if EITHER: -- * its area is in safezone.config.zones (whole-area safe), OR -- * its room hash is in safezone.config.rooms (single-room safe) -- -- Single rooms are keyed by gmcp.Room.Info.id (the unique room hash the -- mapper also uses), so marking one room safe does NOT mark the rest of -- its area. A room can be made safe even inside a non-safe area. -- -- Detection uses the gmcp.Room.Info event. -- -- Commands: -- sz list — list safe areas AND safe rooms -- sz items — list forbidden items -- sz status — show current location + safe state -- sz addzone <name> — add a whole-area safe zone -- sz rmzone <name> — remove a safe zone -- sz addroom [label] — mark the CURRENT room safe (optional label) -- sz rmroom — un-mark the CURRENT room -- sz additem <name> — add a forbidden item -- sz rmitem <name> — remove a forbidden item -- ============================================================
safezone = safezone or {}
-- ---- Configuration ---------------------------------------------------
safezone.config = safezone.config or {}
-- Whole-area safe zones (exact area name, case-insensitive). safezone.config.zones = safezone.config.zones or { ["city of vaerlon"] = true, ["vaerlon shops"] = true, ["mages of valkor"] = true, ["army of vaerlon guild"] = true, ["city-state of atherton"] = true, ["snowfall"] = true, ["vaerlon"] = true, }
-- Single safe rooms, keyed by room hash. Value is a small table holding a -- human-friendly label (room name when marked) for display. -- { ["<hash>"] = { label = "Some Room (City of X)" } } safezone.config.rooms = safezone.config.rooms or {}
-- Items forbidden in safe locations. -- Format: { name = "display name", remove_cmd = "remove X", wear_cmd = "wear X" } safezone.config.items = safezone.config.items or { { name = "Pendant of Violence", remove_cmd = "remove pendant of violence", wear_cmd = "wear pendant of violence", }, }
-- ---- Runtime state ---------------------------------------------------
safezone.state = safezone.state or { inSafe = false, -- are we currently in a safe location? currentArea = "", -- last known area name currentRoom = "", -- last known room hash currentName = "", -- last known room name removedItems = {}, -- items we removed; re-equip on exit }
-- ---- Helpers ---------------------------------------------------------
local function szNote(msg) cecho("\n<cyan>[safezone]<reset> " .. msg .. "\n") end
-- A location is safe if the area is a safe zone OR the room is a safe room. local function isSafe(area, roomHash) if area and area ~= "" and safezone.config.zones[area:lower()] then return true, "area" end if roomHash and roomHash ~= "" and safezone.config.rooms[roomHash] then return true, "room" end return false, nil end
-- ---- Core logic ------------------------------------------------------
-- Remove forbidden items on entering a safe location. function safezone.onEnterSafe(why, label) szNote(string.format("Entering safe %s: <yellow>%s<reset>", why, label)) safezone.state.removedItems = {}
-- Small delay so the room description finishes printing first. tempTimer(0.3, function() for _, item in ipairs(safezone.config.items) do local nameWords = item.name:lower():gsub("[^%a%s]", ""):match("(%a+)") or "item" local triggered = false tempRegexTrigger( "(?i)you (?:stop wearing|remove|take off).*" .. nameWords, function() if not triggered then triggered = true table.insert(safezone.state.removedItems, item) szNote(string.format( "<green>Removed<reset> %s — will re-equip on exit.", item.name)) end end, 1) send(item.remove_cmd, false) end end) end
-- Re-equip on leaving a safe location. function safezone.onExitSafe(toLabel) if #safezone.state.removedItems == 0 then return end szNote(string.format( "Leaving safe location → <yellow>%s<reset>. Re-equipping…", toLabel))
local delay = 0.4 for _, item in ipairs(safezone.state.removedItems) do local cmd, name = item.wear_cmd, item.name tempTimer(delay, function() send(cmd, false) szNote(string.format("<green>Re-equipped<reset> %s.", name)) end) delay = delay + 0.3 end safezone.state.removedItems = {} end
-- ---- GMCP Room.Info handler ------------------------------------------
function safezone.onRoomInfo() local r = gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info if not r then return end
local area = r.area and tostring(r.area) or "" local hash = r.id and tostring(r.id) or "" local name = r.name and tostring(r.name) or ""
local wasSafe = safezone.state.inSafe local nowSafe, why = isSafe(area, hash)
safezone.state.currentArea = area safezone.state.currentRoom = hash safezone.state.currentName = name safezone.state.inSafe = nowSafe
if not wasSafe and nowSafe then local label = (why == "room") and (name ~= "" and name or "this room") or area safezone.onEnterSafe(why, label) elseif wasSafe and not nowSafe then safezone.onExitSafe(area ~= "" and area or (name ~= "" and name or "elsewhere")) end end
-- ---- Management commands --------------------------------------------
function safezone.listZones() local names = {} for k in pairs(safezone.config.zones) do names[#names+1] = k end table.sort(names) cecho("\n<cyan>[safezone]<reset> <white>Safe areas:<reset>\n") if #names == 0 then cecho(" (none)\n") else for _, n in ipairs(names) do cecho(string.format(" <yellow>%s<reset>\n", n)) end end
local rooms = {} for hash, info in pairs(safezone.config.rooms) do rooms[#rooms+1] = { hash = hash, label = info.label or "(unnamed)" } end table.sort(rooms, function(a, b) return a.label < b.label end) cecho("<cyan>[safezone]<reset> <white>Safe rooms:<reset>\n") if #rooms == 0 then cecho(" (none)\n") else for _, rm in ipairs(rooms) do cecho(string.format(" <yellow>%s<reset> <grey>[%s]<reset>\n", rm.label, rm.hash)) end end end
function safezone.listItems() cecho("\n<cyan>[safezone]<reset> <white>Forbidden items:<reset>\n") if #safezone.config.items == 0 then cecho(" (none)\n") else for i, item in ipairs(safezone.config.items) do cecho(string.format( " %d. <yellow>%s<reset> remove: <grey>%s<reset> wear: <grey>%s<reset>\n", i, item.name, item.remove_cmd, item.wear_cmd)) end end end
function safezone.status() local s = safezone.state local _, why = isSafe(s.currentArea, s.currentRoom) cecho("\n<cyan>[safezone]<reset> <white>Status:<reset>\n") cecho(string.format(" Current area : <yellow>%s<reset>\n", s.currentArea ~= "" and s.currentArea or "(unknown)")) cecho(string.format(" Current room : <yellow>%s<reset> <grey>[%s]<reset>\n", s.currentName ~= "" and s.currentName or "(unknown)", s.currentRoom ~= "" and s.currentRoom or "no hash")) cecho(string.format(" Safe here : %s%s\n", s.inSafe and "<green>yes<reset>" or "<red>no<reset>", s.inSafe and string.format(" <grey>(via %s)<reset>", why or "?") or "")) if #s.removedItems > 0 then cecho(" Held for re-equip:\n") for _, item in ipairs(s.removedItems) do cecho(string.format(" - <yellow>%s<reset>\n", item.name)) end end end
function safezone.addZone(name) local key = name:lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if key == "" then szNote("Usage: sz addzone <area name>"); return end safezone.config.zones[key] = true szNote(string.format("Added safe area: <yellow>%s<reset>", key)) end
function safezone.removeZone(name) local key = name:lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if safezone.config.zones[key] then safezone.config.zones[key] = nil szNote(string.format("Removed safe area: <yellow>%s<reset>", key)) else szNote(string.format("Area not found: <yellow>%s<reset>", key)) end end
-- Mark the CURRENT room (by its hash) safe, without affecting its area. function safezone.addRoom(label) local hash = safezone.state.currentRoom if not hash or hash == "" then szNote("<red>Can't mark this room: no room id yet.<reset> Move once, then retry.") return end label = (label and label:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")) or "" if label == "" then local nm = safezone.state.currentName local ar = safezone.state.currentArea if nm ~= "" and ar ~= "" then label = string.format("%s (%s)", nm, ar) elseif nm ~= "" then label = nm else label = "Room " .. hash end end safezone.config.rooms[hash] = { label = label } szNote(string.format("Marked safe room: <yellow>%s<reset> <grey>[%s]<reset>", label, hash)) -- If we're standing in it and weren't safe before, trigger removal now. if not safezone.state.inSafe then safezone.state.inSafe = true safezone.onEnterSafe("room", label) end end
-- Un-mark the CURRENT room. function safezone.removeRoom() local hash = safezone.state.currentRoom if not hash or hash == "" then szNote("<red>No current room id.<reset>") return end if safezone.config.rooms[hash] then local label = safezone.config.rooms[hash].label or hash safezone.config.rooms[hash] = nil szNote(string.format("Un-marked safe room: <yellow>%s<reset>", label)) -- If this room was the only reason we're safe, re-equip on the spot. local stillSafe = isSafe(safezone.state.currentArea, hash) if not stillSafe and safezone.state.inSafe then safezone.state.inSafe = false safezone.onExitSafe(safezone.state.currentArea ~= "" and safezone.state.currentArea or "here") end else szNote("This room is not marked safe.") end end
function safezone.addItem(name) local n = name:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if n == "" then szNote("Usage: sz additem <item name>"); return end table.insert(safezone.config.items, { name = n, remove_cmd = "remove " .. n:lower(), wear_cmd = "wear " .. n:lower(), }) szNote(string.format("Added forbidden item: <yellow>%s<reset>", n)) end
function safezone.removeItem(name) local key = name:lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") for i, item in ipairs(safezone.config.items) do if item.name:lower() == key then table.remove(safezone.config.items, i) szNote(string.format("Removed forbidden item: <yellow>%s<reset>", item.name)) return end end szNote(string.format("Item not found: <yellow>%s<reset>", key)) end
-- ---- Bootstrap ------------------------------------------------------- -- Named to match the Script so its declared sysLoadEvent / sysInstall -- handlers run it on install and on every profile load. Also called once -- at parse time as a fallback. function IceSafeZone() if safezone._roomHandler then killAnonymousEventHandler(safezone._roomHandler) end safezone._roomHandler = registerAnonymousEventHandler( "gmcp.Room.Info", "safezone.onRoomInfo")
local zn = 0; for _ in pairs(safezone.config.zones) do zn = zn + 1 end local rn = 0; for _ in pairs(safezone.config.rooms) do rn = rn + 1 end cecho(string.format( "\n<cyan>[safezone loaded]<reset> %d item(s), %d area(s), %d room(s). " .. "Type <white>sz status<reset> | <white>sz list<reset> | <white>sz addroom<reset>.\n", #safezone.config.items, zn, rn)) end
-- Run now (covers live-parse installs). IceSafeZone()

HelpPackage.HelpEntry:
SAFE ZONE MANAGER — IceSafeZone ================================
Removes forbidden items when you enter a safe location and re-equips them when you leave. A location is safe if its AREA is a safe zone, or if the specific ROOM has been marked safe.
COMMANDS -------- sz list List safe areas and safe rooms sz items List forbidden items sz status Show current area/room and safe state sz addzone <name> Add a whole-area safe zone sz rmzone <name> Remove a safe zone sz addroom [label] Mark the CURRENT room safe (rest of area unaffected) sz rmroom Un-mark the CURRENT room sz additem <name> Add a forbidden item (uses "remove X" / "wear X") sz rmitem <name> Remove a forbidden item
SINGLE SAFE ROOMS ----------------- "sz addroom" marks only the room you are standing in, keyed by its unique room id (the same hash the mapper uses). The rest of that room's area stays non-safe. Stand in the room, then type "sz addroom" (optionally with a label, e.g. "sz addroom Bank vault"). Marking a room you are currently in removes forbidden items immediately; "sz rmroom" re-equips them if that room was the only reason you were safe.
DEFAULT ZONES ------------- City of Vaerlon, Vaerlon Shops, Mages of Valkor, Army of Vaerlon Guild, City-State of Atherton, Snowfall, Vaerlon
DEFAULT FORBIDDEN ITEMS ----------------------- Pendant of Violence
NOTES ----- - Area / room detection uses gmcp.Room.Info (area + id fields). - Removal is attempted after a short delay so the room description prints first; a confirmed removal is queued for re-equipping on exit. - If you were not wearing an item, the MUD's "you aren't wearing that" message is harmless.
